description: Extension of data/noncoulomb (R-015) to the SO odd series and j = 28 (T-046). Per SU(3)_R highest-weight sector with graviton classes: grav (from the complete hw scan), coulomb = rank of the graviton hw vectors on Cartan-valued letters, noncoulomb = grav - coulomb (positive counts rechecked with a second seed and doubled functionals: coulomb_recheck). Files: noncoulomb_so7_j18.jsonl (SO(7), all j <= 18), noncoulomb_so9_j22.jsonl (SO(9), all j <= 22), noncoulomb_so11_j24.jsonl (SO(11), all j <= 24), noncoulomb_so7_j28.jsonl and noncoulomb_usp6_j28.jsonl (j = 28). Result: none for SO(7) j <= 18 (165 graviton classes), SO(9) j <= 22 (664), SO(11) j <= 24 (1331); at j = 28 SO(7) 4 sectors with 1 each ((6,4,4) 2J=4, (7,4,3) 2J=2, (7,4,3) 2J=4, (8,3,3) 2J=2) and USp(6) 2 ((7,4,3) 2J=2, (8,3,3) 2J=2); Coulomb counts equal sector by sector between SO(7) and USp(6).
computed_by: Fortuity collaboration (Claude agent), laptop, 2026-10-06 (five parallel processes; 13 s to 880 s each)
code: fortuity.hwcoh.noncoulomb (CLI), GEN_NMAX = 10 (SO(7) j<=18, SO(9)), 12 (SO(11)), 8 (SO(7), USp(6) at j = 28), each >= the GEN_NMAX of the source scan and above the top Casimir degree 2N
command: cd code; python -m fortuity.hwcoh.noncoulomb SO_odd 3 10 OUT ../data/so_sp/so7_hw_cohomology_j18.jsonl; ... SO_odd 4 10 OUT ../data/so_sp/so9_hw_cohomology_j20.jsonl ../data/so_sp/so9_hw_cohomology_j22.jsonl; ... SO_odd 5 12 OUT ../data/so_sp/so11_hw_cohomology_j24.jsonl; ... SO_odd 3 8 OUT ../data/g2/so7_hw_cohomology_j28.jsonl; ... Sp 3 8 OUT ../data/g2/usp6_hw_cohomology_j28.jsonl (logs in logs_2026-10-06/)
checked: Same code as R-015's files (which it regenerates identically, README.meta.json). A zero noncoulomb is exact (random evaluation can only lower the Cartan rank); every positive count was recomputed with seed 1234 and doubled functionals and agreed. Cross-checks: (8,3,3) 2J = 2, 4, 6 at j = 28 reproduce R-019 (iv)'s independent direct counts 41/40, 31/31, 3/3 for both groups; SO(7) and USp(6) Coulomb counts agree in all 62 sectors at j = 28, as S-duality requires (R-015 (d)); grav totals equal the scan totals (SO(7) 1304, USp(6) 1302 at j = 28).
